Summary: **This is the sequel to Bruce and Selina** Bruce Wayne finally chooses the life he once believed he couldn't have - a wife, a daughter, and a world he's trying to hold together. But peace in Gotham never comes without a cost. When an old debt pulls Selina into something she can't walk away from, secrets begin to fracture the foundation of both their marriage and the Justice League. As whispers of invasion spread and trust begins to erode, Bruce is forced to make an impossible choice: Stand with the world. Or stand with his family. entry.title: Bruce Wayne's Guide to Effective Employee Retention
entry.summary:
Author: thisisannabanana

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 79,282Chapters: 6/11Kudos: 123

Summary: Bruce Wayne has contingency plans for alien invasions, compromised allies, hostile gods, and the destruction of Gotham. He does not have one for Ligaya Avila handing him her resignation. -or- Bruce looked at her desk, the abandoned coffee, the Gotham Knights mug, the stack of completed briefings. “I don’t know what I’d do without you.” There it was. Warm. Sincere. Thoughtless. Aya stood. She picked up the cream envelope and placed it in his hand. “You’ll have to find out.” —or— After seven years of managing Bruce Wayne’s schedule, secrets, and disasters, Aya is finally ready to build a life of her own. entry.summary:
Author: Obito_x_rock

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 12,310Chapters: 8/?Kudos: 76

Summary: Following a devastating, unprecedented earthquake and official government abandonment, Gotham City is declared an "Uninsurable Disaster Zone" and placed under a strict military blockade. Cut off from the rest of the world, a fierce wave of Gothamite nationalism begins to rise from the rubble. Stripped of his high-tech arsenal, with the Batcave drowned in mud and the Batfamily stranded outside the borders, Bruce Wayne chooses to step forward and lead the city with an open face. This is no longer a war of shadows. It is a brutal battle of logistics, backroom diplomacy with Gotham's underworld, and raw human resilience. Because if the mainland has left them for dead, Gotham will rebuild itself alone.

entry.title: A Completely and Totally Ordinary Family Holiday
entry.summary:
Author: koddarc

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 11,292Chapters: 7/9Kudos: 42

Summary: Bruce must be having some kind of mid-life crisis because, after more than a decade of parenthood, he's decided that it's finally time to attempt a family holiday. Which is a lot easier said than done when at least two of your sons are homicidal maniacs and probably all of them have good reason to hate you. For reasons he himself can't explain, Dick agrees to help Bruce try to make this trip to Europe a success. Chaos ensues. Read on for general batfamily antics, drunken father-son bonding, Bruce Wayne having fun and just generally a lot of fluff, with sprinklings of culture and emotions.   The first time that Bruce mentioned it, remarking in an offhand, uninspired way that they ought to go on a family holiday, Dick had thought that it was a joke. “Ha ha.” He replied dryly. “I don’t even want to think about what that would be like.” His adoptive father was near impossible to read and prided himself on this. Still, Dick had known and lived with him long enough now to recognise the barely perceptible signs of his face falling- stiffened jaw, colder than usual eyes, a hand defensively combing through his hair. “Oh.” Dick frowned. “You were serious.”
